methodologyNotes: Products selected as notable 24V low-voltage smart thermostats (plus one mini-split and one high-voltage specialist) a buyer compares in 2026, covering budget through premium tiers. Seeds from prompt verified and expanded to 13 products. Primary sources: manufacturer product pages (ecobee.com, wyze.com, honeywellhome.com, getmysa.com, sensi.copeland.com), Wikipedia (Nest Learning Thermostat article for generation/release-date data), SafeWise review blog (safewise.com/blog/best-smart-thermostats), and HowToGeek (howtogeek.com) for corroboration. Google Store pages consistently served truncated JS-rendered content; specs cross-confirmed via Wikipedia, SafeWise, and 9to5Google search snippets. Amazon.com consistently returned 5xx errors; Amazon Smart Thermostat specs sourced from SafeWise review. Honeywell T9/T10 Pro verified via honeywellhome.com product pages (both now discontinued/sold out). priceUsd is US MSRP at time of research (2026-06-15) or launch MSRP where current page shows 'sold out'. Mysa prices are listed in CAD on manufacturer site; USD equivalents at parity noted as null with explanation. accessedAt = 2026-06-15 for all sources.
